description: Combined Sewer Overflow Annual Results is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. This data was created for Federal and Provincial Government reporting by the City of Winnipeg’s Water and Waste Department to track the combined sewer overflow (CSO) volume and days effluent is deposited. All volumes are noted in m³. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Water and Waste. Its tags are cso, overflows, sewer, combined sewer, outfall. The table has 93 columns. The portal shows 2026-06-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
